ready1_open_rewrite.title: GeoSQA open-ended question (2)
ready1_open_rewrite.rewritten_question_text: Water resource utilization rate refers to the ratio of water consumption in a river basin or region to the exploitable amount of water resources. Internationally, it is generally believed that the limit for reasonable development of a river is a water resource utilization rate of 40%. The figure below is a schematic diagram of the development and utilization rates of water resources in some regions of our country. According to the material and <image1>, what other main reason for the lack of water resources in the Hexi Corridor is that which type of local water consumption is large?
